expressions.en: I will follow up on this.
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan susul mengenai perkara ini.

expressions.bm_casual: Thanks for your cooperation. / Terima kasih banyak.

expressions.en: I'll get back to you shortly.
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan maklumkan semula kepada anda tidak lama lagi.
expressions.bm_casual: Nanti saya reply balik. / Saya akan maklumkan sekejap lagi.

work.scenario: You're at the office. Your manager asks you to prepare a report and follow up with a client regarding a pending payment. You also need to thank a colleague for their help.
key_phrases: Sila hantar laporan itu kepada saya.
Saya akan susul mengenai perkara ini.

life.scenario: You're organizing a family gathering. You need to confirm the date with your relatives, clarify the potluck arrangements, and promise to send the final details soon.
key_phrases: Jom kita set meeting untuk bincang tarikh.
Saya nak tanya sikit pasal makanan siapa nak bawa apa.
Nanti saya reply balik details penuh.

tech.scenario: You're troubleshooting a software issue with a tech support agent. You need to request log files, ask for more details on the next steps, and confirm you'll send the requested info quickly.
key_phrases: Sila hantar arahan untuk dapatkan log files.
Saya memerlukan penjelasan mengenai langkah seterusnya.
Saya akan maklumkan semula fail log tidak lama lagi.

quiz_toggle.question: How do you formally ask someone to 'Please send me the proposal'?
quiz_toggle.answer: Sila hantar cadangan itu kepada saya.
